rubric.checkpoint: Three binary factual checkpoints per question; equivalent wording accepted.
rubric.correct: 3/3 checkpoints and no material additional factual error.
rubric.partial: 1–2 checkpoints, or 3/3 with a material additional factual error.
rubric.abstain: No substantive answer; uncertainty plus substantive content is not abstention.
rubric.missing: Not received or technical failure; kept separate and excluded from observed denominators. None remain.
rubric.materiality: A false operational, API, type, or version claim can change a judgment. Minor formatting or an isolated label contradicted by a correct explicit explanation does not.
rubric.sensitivity: A separate required-checkpoints-only count shows the effect of the additional-error rule without replacing the primary rule.
